maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is advertising sold on billboards and transit displays, not repair or maintenance of customers' installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Advertisers such as consumer brands pay for billboard and transit ad space; government transit authorities are lessors, not main payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling ad space on its own billboard and transit displays and digitizing them, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can easily shift campaign budgets to other outdoor, digital or media suppliers; advertising is a discretionary purchase.
